_comment: Static project configuration. Edited by developers only; the Council maintainer never needs to touch this file.

treasury.label: DAO Treasury
treasury._indexNote: The Treasury ATLAS account receives ~20k fee transfers a day, so it is not scanned. Its outflows are still captured through the wallet, which signs every payout.

income._note: Inflows from a counterparty that sends at least this many transfers are summarised per month instead of listed one by one.

sheet._tabsNote: Each tab is a gid (digits) or a tab name. Named tabs are found automatically once they exist, including tabs created from the dashboard's editor.

editing._note: Two-way editing between the dashboard and the sheet. Off while googleClientId is empty. The client ID is public by design (it identifies the app, it grants nothing); access is decided by each editor's own permissions on the sheet.

rpc._note: RPC_URL (env) is used for balances and transaction lookups; any provider works. SIGNATURES_RPC_URL (env) is used to list each address's transaction history and MUST be archive-complete: some commercial RPCs silently return gaps there. The public endpoint is complete.
